name: npm/@playwright/mcp
title: Playwright
description: Browser automation via Playwright: control web pages using accessibility snapshots so the model does not rely on screenshots.

toolsSummary.name: browser_navigate
toolsSummary.description: Open pages and navigate browser tabs.

toolsSummary.name: browser_click
toolsSummary.description: Click page elements through deterministic accessibility selectors.

toolsSummary.name: browser_fill_form
toolsSummary.description: Fill multi-field forms in one action.

toolsSummary.name: browser_snapshot

io.sami/gallery.about: Playwright MCP exposes deterministic browser automation tools (navigation, interactions, snapshots, network state, tabs) for robust web tasks.
